title: HTTP runtime reply
responsibility: Rejects unsupported methods and invalid JSON before invoking a served unit.

inputs.name: runtimeReply.runtime
inputs.description: The UnitRuntime whose invoke receives the parsed body, and only for a POST whose body parses as JSON and is portable. runtimeReply passes the parsed value as a RuntimeRequest without checking its fields, and never calls close on it.

inputs.name: runtimeReply.method
inputs.description: The HTTP method, accepted only when it is exactly 'POST' (case-sensitive); any other value, including 'post', gets a 405 invalid-request reply before the body is read.

inputs.name: runtimeReply.read
inputs.description: Async reader that returns the request body text, called once and only for POST requests. A rejection or synchronous throw from it is caught and answered as a 400 invalid-json reply rather than rejecting runtimeReply.

outputs.name: runtimeReply
outputs.description: Resolves to a RuntimeReply: status 405 with an invalid-request failure for any method other than POST; status 400 with an invalid-json failure when the body cannot be read, is not valid JSON, or is not portable (a non-finite number, a lone surrogate, or nesting deeper than 64 levels); otherwise status 200 with the runtime's RuntimeResponse unchanged, success or failure. It rejects only when the call to runtime.invoke itself throws or rejects, which runtimeReply does not catch although RuntimeResponse states that transports never throw.

error.message: send one JSON request per POST
